description: Open source fingerprint browser based on Ungoogled Chromium (C++-level, seed-deterministic, can report as real Chrome).
pre_install: Get-Process chrome -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "$dir*" } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $sub = Get-ChildItem "$dir" -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'ungoogled-chromium_' }; foreach ($s in $sub) { Move-Item "$($s.FullName)\*" $dir -Force; Remove-Item $s.FullName -Force -Recurse }
post_uninstall: Get-Process chrome -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "*$dir*" } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
notes: Enable fingerprinting with: chrome.exe --fingerprint <32-bit-seed> --fingerprint-platform windows --fingerprint-brand Chrome --timezone <IANA-tz>. Point OpenBrowser's kernel path at: <scoop dir>\fingerprint-chromium\current\chrome.exe
